"''At a private landing field, near the Roalj Temple…property of one of our donors.|Marda Ro and Elecia Zeveron|}} A '''private landing field''' was located in the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[moon]] [[Jedha]] near the [[Roalj Temple]]. By [[382 BBY]], it was owned by a [[Unidentified donor|donor]] of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] [[Religion|cult]]. That [[Standard year|year]], when the [[prospector]] [[Radicaz Dobbs|Sunshine Dobbs]] traveled to Jedha with the Path of the Open Hand, he landed his [[yacht]], the ''[[Scupper]]'', at the landing field. After the Path's [[Mother (title)|Mother]]—a [[Gender|woman]] named [[Elecia Zeveron]]—was injured during the [[Battle of Jedha]], she and the Path's [[Guide of the Closed Fist|Guide]] [[Marda Ro]] set out to the field. They eventually reached it, accompanied by the [[Ovissian]] [[Bokana Koss]] and a [[Shrikarai|creature]] known as the [[Great Leveler|Leveler]], and departed Jedha. ==Description== The private landing field was located in the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' [[moon]] [[Jedha]] near the [[Roalj Temple]]. ==History== [[File:MardaRoEleciaZeveron-ChroniclesoftheJedi.png|thumb|right|350px|Marda Ro (left) and Elecia Zeveron (right) sought to make their way to the private landing field after Zeveron was injured.]] By [[382 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'' to [[382 BBY]]. during the [[High Republic Era]], the field was owned by a [[Unidentified donor|donor]] of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] [[Religion|cult]]. That [[Standard year|year]], the [[prospector]] [[Radicaz Dobbs|Sunshine Dobbs]] landed his [[yacht]], the ''[[Scupper]]'', at the landing field when he visited Jedha alongside the members of the Path of the Open Hand. While on the moon, [[Elecia Zeveron]]—a [[Gender|woman]] who served as the Path's [[Mother (title)|Mother]]—became injured during the [[Battle of Jedha]]. After Zeveron explained to the Path's [[Guide of the Closed Fist|Guide]]—the [[Evereni]] [[Marda Ro]]—that she would need to return to Dobb's [[Starship|vessel]], as the [[Gaze's landing shuttle|shuttle]] she had traveled to Jedha on had been destroyed, Ro questioned the Mother if she knew where the ''Scupper'' was. In response, Zeveron noted it was at the private landing field. The two, along with the [[Ovissian]] [[Bokana Koss]], set out for the field. As they headed toward it, the Evereni lamented that the journey across the [[city]] was proving to be a long one. Eventually, the three, by then also accompanied by a [[Shrikarai|creature]] known as the [[Great Leveler|Leveler]], reached the ''Scupper'' and left Jedha. In [[1 BBY]], the Holy City was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. ==Behind the scenes== The Holy City private landing field was mentioned in the [[2023]] young-adult novel ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project's [[Phase II: Quest of the Jedi|Phase II]].{{HighRepublicReaderGuide}} ==Appearances== *''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: Path of Vengeance (audiobook)}} {{1stm|in book}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Jedha City locations]]
